title: Captain's Helm (Ships)
layout_order: strip above the panel: ship name / CAPTAIN'S HELM - you have the helm | crew (left), then from the right X, HELP, PANEL, AUTO | panel (1600 x 304 mock, left / centre / right anchors; compact: compass and log on their own row above): LEFT the ship's wheel with the helm words, sail plan box (sails lit as set, setting name), FURL BATTLE PLAIN ALL, DROP/WEIGH ANCHOR, ASTERN | CENTRE status line, HEADING figure and point, compass card (no-go wedge, true and apparent wind arrows, lubber line), WIND line, speed log (knots, hull speed arc, ASTERN/KNOTS, HEEL/UPRIGHT, point of sail) | RIGHT WIND SHE SAILS ON: WOLF WX REGION FIXED, LIGHT AIRS, wind line, source, FIXED steppers, captain/crew line, keys line | BATTLE box: BATTLE mode button, flag, seven health bars, PORT / STBD broadsides with reload rings, note, BOOTY | guide card over the world | resize grip on the top edge

controls.label: the panel itself: clicks and right-clicks never reach the world
source: return true;   // the panel itself: not a click on the world behind it
return (mDrawn && mResize.onGrip(x, y)) || onPanel(x, y);   // no world context menu through the panel

controls.name: empty-states
controls.label: Sit at the wheel of a ship to take the helm. / Reading the ship's log... / Hailing the ship... / This vessel does not speak the Captain's Helm. (+ sub-lines), or the last error in amber
source: msg = "Sit at the wheel of a ship to take the helm.";
sub = "Right-click the wheel > Sit Here. The Captain's Helm opens by itself for a ship that speaks it (HMS Wolfy).";
sub = "No answer yet: a Wolf ship's helm script answers within a few seconds. Other vessels do not speak the Captain's Helm.";
msg = "This vessel does not speak the Captain's Helm.";
sub = "Its helm script did not answer. Sailing Mode (Wolf World > Vehicles & Travel) works with any boat.";

controls.label: the ship's wheel (turns 6x the rudder) with PORT n° / STARBOARD n° / MIDSHIPS under it
controls.tip: The ship's wheel: drag left or right to put the helm over (it stays), double-click for midships. Left / Right (A / D) steer as before.
controls.action: drag: WolfHelm::setHelm(mPressHelm - travel * mHelmMax); double-click: order("midships"); crew refused
source: "The ship's wheel: drag left or right to put the helm over (it stays), double-click for midships. "

controls.name: sail-plan
controls.label: sail plan picture (fore / main / mizzen sails lit as set) and Furled / Battle sails / Plain sail / All sail
source: static const char* const SETTINGS[4] = { "Furled", "Battle sails", "Plain sail", "All sail" };

controls.label: FURL
controls.when: ship ready; enabled for the captain
controls.tip: Furl every sail (+ ' (the captain's order)' for crew)
source: const std::string capt_only = orders ? "" : " (the captain's order)";

controls.label: BATTLE
controls.tip: Battle sails: topsails, jib and spanker
source: "BATTLE", s.mSail == 1, H_BATTLE_SAILS, "Battle sails: topsails, jib and spanker" + capt_only

controls.label: PLAIN
controls.tip: Plain sail: and the courses, topgallants and staysails
source: "PLAIN", s.mSail == 2, H_PLAIN, "Plain sail: and the courses, topgallants and staysails" + capt_only

controls.label: ALL
controls.tip: All sail: and the royals and flying jib
source: "ALL", s.mSail == 3, H_ALL, "All sail: and the royals and flying jib" + capt_only

controls.label: DROP ANCHOR / WEIGH ANCHOR
controls.tip: Let go the anchor: she is brought up short / At anchor: weigh anchor to sail
source: "Let go the anchor: she is brought up short"
case H_ANCHOR:        captainOrder(s.mAnchor ? "weigh anchor" : "drop anchor"); break;

controls.label: ASTERN / STOP ASTERN
controls.tip: The ship's boats tow her astern (sails furled first): to back her off a shoal or the edge / The boats stop towing
source: "The ship's boats tow her astern (sails furled first): to back her off a shoal or the edge"

controls.name: status-line
controls.label: No answer from the ship... (red) / the last refusal (amber, until the next press) / the ship's say line / the point of sail; + '(n standing aboard: they must sit)'
source: status = "No answer from the ship: is her helm script running? Shout /7 status to ask her.";
status += llformat("   (%d standing aboard: they must sit)", s.mStanding);

controls.name: refusals
controls.label: Only the captain at the wheel gives the ship's orders. / She cannot change battle mode while she is sinking or sunk. / Waiting for the gun deck's report. / Battle mode goes off in n s ... / The guns are silenced for n s. / Switch battle mode on to fire. / The port|starboard guns are reloading: n s.
source: refuse("Only the captain at the wheel gives the ship's orders.");
"She cannot change battle mode while she is sinking or sunk." : "Waiting for the gun deck's report."
refuse(llformat("Battle mode goes off in %d s (it stays on 60 s, so no one can dodge a fight)."
refuse(llformat("The guns are silenced for %d s."
refuse("Switch battle mode on to fire.");

controls.name: compass
controls.label: heading-up compass: N E S W card, ticks, ship, red no-go wedge (brighter in irons), true wind arrow (blue), apparent wind (teal), lubber line; HEADING nnn° and point; WIND n kn <point>

controls.name: speed-log
controls.label: speed log 0..20+ kn, hull speed arc in red, needle, n.n, KNOTS / ASTERN, HEEL n° STBD|PORT / UPRIGHT, point of sail (BECALMED, IN IRONS, CLOSE-HAULED, BEAM REACH, BROAD REACH, RUNNING BEFORE THE WIND)
WOLF WX (under WIND SHE SAILS ON)
controls.tip: Wolf weather: the real weather of this region's place
source: "Wolf weather: the real weather of this region's place" + capt_only

controls.label: REGION
controls.tip: The region's own wind (the one Sailing Mode's dial shows)
source: "The region's own wind (the one Sailing Mode's dial shows)" + capt_only

controls.label: FIXED
controls.tip: A wind you set: knots and the bearing it blows from (the steppers below)
controls.action: WolfHelm::setFixedWind(kn, from) - the wind she has now, held
source: "A wind you set: knots and the bearing it blows from (the steppers below)" + capt_only
h.setFixedWind(kn, from);   // FIXED: the wind she has now, held

controls.label: LIGHT AIRS (green when on); n kn from nnn°; sails as in n kn; wind source text
controls.tip: Light airs help on: under 8 knots of wind she sails as if it blew 8. Click for the real wind only / Light airs help off: she sails on the real wind only. Click to help her in light airs
source: "Light airs help on: under 8 knots of wind she sails as if it blew 8. Click for the real wind only"
"Light airs help off: she sails on the real wind only. Click to help her in light airs"
case H_LIGHT_AIRS:    captainOrder(s.mLight ? "light airs off" : "light airs on"); break;

controls.label: - (knots)
controls.tip: One knot less

controls.label: + (knots)
controls.tip: One knot more

controls.label: - (bearing)
controls.tip: Back the wind 10 degrees
source: "-", false, H_FROM_DOWN, "Back the wind 10 degrees" + capt_only

controls.label: + (bearing)
controls.tip: Veer the wind 10 degrees
source: "+", false, H_FROM_UP, "Veer the wind 10 degrees" + capt_only

controls.name: crew-line
controls.label: YOU HAVE THE HELM / CREW: THE CAPTAIN GIVES THE ORDERS; Keys: Left/Right helm, PgUp/PgDn sail
source: captain ? "YOU HAVE THE HELM" : "CREW: THE CAPTAIN GIVES THE ORDERS"

controls.name: no-guns
controls.label: BATTLE / No guns fitted yet / Battle mode comes with the naval script.
source: "Battle mode comes with the naval script."

controls.label: BATTLE: ON / BATTLE: OFF / ON - n s / SILENCED / SINKING / SUNK
controls.when: naval script; enabled with a battle report and not sinking / sunk
controls.tip: Battle mode is on: ... Click to switch it off (it stays on for 60 s after, so no one can dodge a fight) / Switch battle mode on: ... Ships with it off are never touched
source: "Battle mode is on: she can fire on, and be hit by, any other ship in battle mode. Click to switch it off "
"Switch battle mode on: she can fire on, and be hit and sunk by, other ships in battle mode, on any region. "

controls.name: flag
controls.label: the Jolly Roger while battle mode is on, a plain red pennant otherwise (waving)
source: // the flag: the Jolly Roger flies while battle mode is on, a plain red pennant otherwise

controls.name: health-bars
controls.label: seven section bars: BOW STERN PORT STBD WATERLINE RUDDER RIGGING
PORT broadside with reload ring (FIRE / n s / -)
controls.when: naval script; can fire with battle on or switching off
controls.tip: Fire the port broadside (the guns on her left side). The ring fills as they reload
source: "Fire the port broadside (the guns on her left side). The ring fills as they reload"

controls.label: STBD broadside with reload ring
controls.tip: Fire the starboard broadside (the guns on her right side). The ring fills as they reload
source: "Fire the starboard broadside (the guns on her right side). The ring fills as they reload"

controls.name: battle-note
controls.label: Waiting for the gun deck's report... / SHE IS SINKING / SUNK - she will be restored / GUNS SILENCED n s / COLOURS STRUCK / PROTECTED n s / LOCKED IN BATTLE n s / DAMAGED: sails n%, helm n%
source: note = "Waiting for the gun deck's report...";

controls.label: BOOTY <hoard> #rank; +n doubloons (from <ship>)! / doubloons won in battle

controls.name: ship-name
controls.label: <ship name> or CAPTAIN'S HELM, - you have the helm / - crew (strip, left)
source: who += captain ? "  -  you have the helm" : "  -  crew";

"Opens only by hand: click to have it open by itself when you take a ship's helm"
